name: rudra
description: A personal AI agent with a native desktop GUI and a real memory.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tooling/schema-to-dart/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tooling/smoke/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tooling/fmt-dart/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tooling/logo/tsconfig.json
scripts.fix: bun run lint:fix && bun run fmt
scripts.check: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run codegen:check && bun run logo:check && bun run test
scripts.app:check: bun run app:fmt:check && bun run app:analyze && bun run app:test
scripts.check:all: bun run check && bun run app:check && bun run app:spine && bun run smoke
scripts.app:preview: cd app && flutter test test/palette_preview_test.dart --tags preview
